attrs.data-about: Billie, an impulsive teenager, discovers she has magical powers and is pulled into a hidden world of witches. With her cautious mother she starts to uncover family secrets that could change that world.
attrs.data-where: Cinemas in the Netherlands from 25 Nov, Pathé and Vue

attrs.data-about: The two Gaulish heroes leave their village for Nubia, south of ancient Egypt, in a story written for the big screen rather than adapted from an existing album. French animated family adventure directed by Alexandre Heboyan.
attrs.data-where: French cinemas from 2 Dec (Dutch date not verified)

attrs.data-about: Bill Hader voices the Cat, who now works for an organisation that sends him to cheer up children. His latest job is two siblings adjusting to a new town, and if his love of chaos goes too far he could lose his magic hat. Warner Bros. Pictures Animation's first feature, animated by DNEG.

AJ, a shy Los Angeles teenager who draws and skates, meets Kristen, a fearless surfer who teaches him the sport and its Hawaiian roots. As they fall for each other he starts drawing their story to hold on to it.

Heroes from three different universes join forces against an existential threat unlike any they have faced. Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal headline, with Chris Hemsworth and Chris Evans returning.
attrs.data-where: Cinemas in the Netherlands from 18 Dec, Pathé and Vue

attrs.data-about: Denis Villeneuve's final Dune film, adapting Frank Herbert's Dune Messiah, follows Paul Atreides years into his reign as emperor.
Brad Bird's retro-futuristic animated noir for Netflix, set in a world of 1950s style science fiction.
attrs.data-where: Netflix in December, limited 70mm cinema run first

attrs.data-about: Red, Chuck, Bomb and the flock return for a third animated adventure, now released by Paramount.
The next Ice Age film from 20th Century Animation.
attrs.data-where: Cinemas, Netherlands date to be confirmed

attrs.data-about: Greta Gerwig's prequel shows how Narnia began: two London children, Digory and Polly, are sent into other worlds by his magician uncle's rings and accidentally free an evil sorceress. Daniel Craig plays Uncle Andrew.
Mark Grayson returns for a fifth season with Thragg and the Viltrumite threat still hanging over Earth. Prime Video has confirmed only the month so far.
